tei:div.tei:p: 173) ༄༅/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad deng 'dir dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnams kyis dam pa'i chos 'chad nyan bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag gis mtshon/ sngar bsags zin pa'i dge ba ma 'ongs pa na gsog par 'gyur ba/ da lta gsog bzhin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i zag med kyi dge rtsa/ sems can thams cad kyi zag bcas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdus shing bzlums ste bsdoms nas/ gang du bsngo na/ phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas thub dbang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ mdo sde snod gsum/ sngags rgyud sde bzhi sogs rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gyi bdag rkyen las byung ba'i bka' dang*/ 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs kyi dgongs 'grel rnam par dag pa sogs phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i dam pa'i chos 'gog lam gyis bsdus pa mtha' dag nyi zlas gar khyab nor bu 'dzin ma'i tha gru kun tu dar zhing rgyas/ ji srid nam mkha' stong par ma gyur bar de srid du rtag cing brtan par 'jig rten gyi snang bar bzhugs su gsol bar smon pa lhan gcig gnang bar zhu/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ khyad par du 'jam pa'i dbyangs bod mgo nag gi rje bo khri srong lde'u btsan dang*/ spyan ras gzigs chos 174)rgyal srong btsan sgam po/ gsang 'dzin bdag po mnga' dag khri ral pa ste chos rgyal mes dbon rnam pa gsum gyi bka' drin las/ za hor gyi mkhan chen bo dhi sa twa shan+ta rak+ṣi ta/ rigs sngags 'chang ba'i rgyal po dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug rtsa gsum kun 'dus o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan paṇa chen bi ma la sogs paṇ+ḍ-i ta brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na/

ska ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu yi rgyal mtshan/ zhang sna nam pa ban+de ye shes sde sogs lo tsā ba brgya dang rtsa brgyad sogs bsgyur bshad lag len gyis gtan la dbab pa'i bstan pa snga 'gyur ba/ theg pa rim pa dgus bsdus pa'i mdo dang sngags kyi chos tshul rab 'byams rgya mtsho ji snyed pa rnams te mtsho skyes rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun du gnas pa'i phyir du/ rgyal ba kun gyi nye lam= khyad par du snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i bstan pa'i gzhi ma mdo rgyu sems kyi bstan pa dang po gnyags la babs/ bar du gnubs la babs/ tha ma zur la babs pas/ zur chen shākya 'byung gnas/ zur shes rab grags pa/ gsang bdag sgro phug pa chen po shākya 'byung gnas yab sras rnams kyis bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas 'dzin pa dang*/ bka' babs bzhi pa snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma pad+ma 175)gar dbang 'gyur maid rdo rjes mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa'i me ro rmang nas gsos te da lta'i bar du snga 'gyur ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun dar zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba ni/ dam pa 'di nyid kho na la rag las pa'i phyir 'di nyid kyi ring lugs dar zhing rgyas la yun du gnas pa'i phyir du/ sa la 'og min= khyad par du snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i khyad chos bla na med pa ni 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po kho na yin cing*/ de nyid kyi bstan pa gzhir bzhengs su slong ba ni kun mkhyen yab sras kho na la rag las pa'i phyir/ skye ba kun tu= zab lam 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag yid bzhin nor bu rin po che 'dzin nus pa'i phyir du/ thub bstan mdzes pa'i= gzhan yang tshes gcig lus gcig la lo dang zla ba tsam gyis grol bar byed pa ni 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po kho na la lags pas/ de nyid kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring gnas par bya ba'i phyir du/

gzhan yang snga 'gyur bka' ma rin po che dang*/ nyang gur byang gsum/ gling pa lnga/ dri med gnyis sogs zab gter rgya mtsho lta bu ste bka' gter gnyis kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa ni/ rig 'dzin chen po kun bzang shes rab yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa lags pas/ 176) de'i brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i skyes mchog gang na bzhugs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi bzhed don thams cad 'grub ste nyin mtshan kun lung sde snod gsum dang*/ lam bslab pa gsum la rtag gus kyi sbyor bas brtson pa'i phyir du/ bkra shis phan bde'i= gzhan yang snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi bdag po gangs can grub pa rgya mtsho'i 'byung khungs rgyal dbang dpal yul ba'i bstan pa bka' gter gser gyi mchod sdong la man ngag snying thig g.yu yi phra tshom gyis brgyan pa 'di nyid phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir du/ bkra shis rgyal ba= gzhan yang snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi bdag po/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub 'khor lo gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin pa'i ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i 'dus pa'i sde thams cad pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa'i khyu 'tshogs pa bzhin du 'du zhing de dag gi kyang lung sde snod gsum la mkhas par bya ba dang*/ mngon rtogs bslab pa gsum gyis rgyud grol/ bskyed dang rdzogs dang rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams bzhes mthar phyin nas tshe lus gcig la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du sgrub pa'i phyir du/ bslab pa gsum ldan= gzhan yang de dag gi mthu la brten nas nor 'dzin yangs pa'i tha gru kun tu yang nad mug 'khrug rtsod/ sad ser 177)btsa' than/ mi nad phyugs nad/ dmag jag chom rkun sogs dus kyi chad pa thams cad nye bar zhi/ mi la tshe/ nor la g.yang*/ zas la bcud sogs snod bcud kyi dwangs ma bcu bzhi'i yon tan thams cad lhun gyi grub nas rdzogs ldan dang po'i dpal yon la longs spyod pa'i phyir du/

'jig rten bde zhing= gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi khams na gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor 'chang ba'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyi rgyud la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che skyes te nyin mtshan rtag tu chos la spyod cing phan pa 'ba' zhig la spyod pa'i phyir du/ 'byung po gang dag= gzhan yang 'jig rten 'di nas dag pa'i zhing khams su byon pa'i gong ma bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs shing*/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du bsam yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar gang la gang 'dul 'gyed nas rtag khyab lhun grub kyi phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir du/ dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dgongs= gzhan yang bstan pa dang sems can yongs kyi dpung gnyen du gyur pa'i mkhas dang grub pa yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ston pa gnyis pa lta bur gyur pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen skyes bu dam pa khyad par can rnams kyi sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan 178)yun ring du bstan pa'i phyir du/ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe= gzhan yang da lta 'dir tshogs pas mtshon/ sdom pa gsum gyi lam la zhugs pa thams cad kyang*/ tshe 'dir yang sdom pa dang dam tshig rnam par dag mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun la spyod/ chos mthun gyi bsam sbyor yid bzhin du 'grub/ skye dang skye bar sa dang lam gyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs te myur du rdzogs byang chub pa'i phyir du/ skye zhing skye ba= gzhan yang 'jig rten 'di nas lnga lam du song ba'i re zhing chags pa'i tshe 'das thams cad kyang*/ bar do'i 'khrul snang zhi/ rigs drug gi gnas ngan dang bral/ rnam grol dbugs chen 'byin pa'i zhing khams lnga'am/ dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can du skyes te/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mtshan stong 'bar gyi mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor mjal/ tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs thos/ mkhyen brtse'i dgongs pa la mngon du rol ba'i phyir du/

tshe 'das ngan song= mdor na 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lngas bsdus pa'i tshe rabs thog med nas drin gyis bskyangs ba'i pha mar gyur pa'i yid can rgya mtsho nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa rnams kyang*/ 'gyur dang 'du byed sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ste/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang*/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa gnyis las log ste/ ma rig pa'i rdzun phug rdib/ gzung 'dzin bag la gzha'/ srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor 179)zhig bden 'dzin gyi mdud pa grol/ 'khor ba ma spangs myang 'das su dag nyon mongs ma spangs ye shes su shar/ 'dod yon ma spangs longs spyod kyis brgyan/ snang srid gzhir bzhugs la gzhir bzhengs su sangs rgyas te/ nang gsal gzhon nu bum skur 'ub chub/ gting gsal phra ba'i ye shes mngon du gyur/ phyi gsal sku dang ye shes mngon du gsal/ ma rig pa'i gzhi las 'phags/ yin min gyi bye brag phyed/ yin nges su phyed thog grol/ grol thog tu btsan sa zin/ zin thog tu 'gyur ba med/ 'gyur med las mi g.yo bar rgyu las ma byung ba'i 'bras bu/ sems las ma byung ba'i rig pa/ lung las ma byung ba'i man ngag zab mo'i gnad thams cad mngon du gyur nas mthar phyin 'bras bu'i gzhi thog tu grol ba'i phyir du/ bsod nams 'di yis= tshul ji ltar bsngo na/ 'phags pas chen po la bzhugs pa'i rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rje btsun rdo rje rnon po dang*/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po sogs nye ba'i sras brgyad/ bskal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po/ rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug pho mo rnams kyis rnam thar gyi rjes su slabs ste bsngo ba ni/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos= der ma zad/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan/ dbang bcu'i dbang gis phyug mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa 180) bco brgyad sogs zag med kyi chos nyer gcig gi bdag nyid rgyal ba yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i 'dren pa rnams kyis sems can gzhan don du dge ba'i rtsa ba ji ltar bsngos pa'i rnam thar dang 'brel bar bsngo ba ni/

dus gsum gshegs pa'i= gzhan yang bde bar gshegs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' 'am bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa/ rig 'dzin rnal 'byor pho mo rnams kyi dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu mdzad/ gzhan don du smon lam rgya mtsho lta bu btab pa rnams dang*/ ji lta dang ji snyed kyi mkhyen pa rgya mtsho lta bu mnga' ba/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig ma yis gdung ba lta bu'i brtse ba'i snying rje chen po mnga' ba/ gzhan don du rtag khyab lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las kyi nus mthu'i stobs thogs pa med par mnga' ba bla na med pa'i ye shes bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i sgyu 'phrul ji lta bu mnga' ba/ de kho na 'dra ba zhig bdag sogs mar gyur mkha' mthas gtugs pa'i skye dgu thams cad de bzhin du 'gyur bar smon pa ni/ bde gshegs sras bcas= mdor na smon lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa la smon pa kho nar 'du bas*/ 'gro ba'i nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po dam pa'i chos kyi phung po ji snyed cig 181)gsungs pa bka' dang dgongs 'grel du gtogs so 'tshal thams cad nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kun tu khyab pa dang*/ khyab nas kyang yid can kun gyis rgyal ba'i mngon du rtogs goms mthar phyin pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par rgyur cig par smon pa ni/ chos tshul 'di yang= de ltar na rang 'dod dang bral zhing gzhan phan pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam dang 'brel ba'i smon lam btab pa'ang 'grub par byed pa'i dpang po ni/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi mthu byin la rag las phyir/ de dag gi bden pa dang bden pa'i stobs ji ltar bsngos pa'i don 'bras thams cad yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang*/ gter chen po'i bum pa/
dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ rigs sngags kyi mchod rten bzhin du 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung bar byin gyi brlab tu gsol zhes bden tshig gi stobs brjod pa dang lhan cig tu/ de ltar 'grub par=
pad+ma ma ṇis gang dran 'chal 'chol du bris// dge'o// 182)
